svg.title: XVI. The Tower: MicrOS
svg.desc: XVI. The Tower, upright. Nix. Experimental operating system based on Nixpkgs module system, bringing Runit to NixOS. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), The stormy blast of hell with restless fury drives the spirits on. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 83. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
